entities.summary: Yun Kwan was a Korean military general of Goryeo who played a pivotal role in training the Pyŏlmuban and leading it to victory against the aggressive Jurchen tribes in the 11th century. This achievement marked a significant turning point in the history of the Goryeo dynasty, as it showcased the military prowess and strategic thinking of Yun Kwan. The victory also had far-reaching consequences, as it helped to secure the borders of Goryeo and prevent the Jurchen tribes from expanding their territory into the Korean Peninsula. Yun Kwan's legacy extends beyond his military victories, as he was also known for his administrative skills and his role in promoting trade and cultural exchange between Goryeo and neighboring countries. His contributions to the Goryeo dynasty have been recognized and celebrated in Korean history, and he remains one of the most important figures in the country's medieval past. Yun Kwan's story is a testament to the enduring power of human ingenuity and determination in the face of adversity.
